subject: All Item Fit Statistics Returning NA in PCM Model

messages.author: 6e06cf60a5577316
messages.subject: All Item Fit Statistics Returning NA in PCM Model
parts:
Hello,

I'm encountering an issue with my PCM model using the mirt package. Below is the code I used:

model_pcm <- mirt.model('F1 = 1-6')
mod_pcm <- mirt(resp, model_pcm, itemtype = "Rasch")
theta_pcm <- fscores(mod_pcm, response.pattern = resp, full.scores = TRUE, method = "EAP")
item_pcm <- coef(mod_pcm, simplify = TRUE, IRTpars = TRUE)$items
fit <- itemfit(mod_pcm, 'infit')

 the item_pcm output is as follows:  

            a          b1          b2          b3          b4          b5
Item.1  1  0.59357731 -1.29003783 -0.03719401  2.8006860 -0.4385158
Item.2  1 -0.39066336 -1.76537371  0.26936686  1.3455186  0.7335256
Item.3  1 -0.03148288 -0.80140780  0.02982592  0.6392047  3.4914807
Item.4  1 -0.41196879 -0.45482527  0.59106754  1.2931319  1.2599363
Item.5  1  0.55203645 -1.82725798  0.22736885  0.7956415  1.3748224
Item.6  1 -0.31248416  0.06353369  0.75503517  0.6914691  2.8636954

  However, when I check the fit statistics,  all the values for outfit, z.outfit, infit, and z.infit are returned as NA for each item. What could be the reason for this?

  Thank you!
